task_message:
Case L41: segment the lipomatous soft-tissue tumor on this T1-weighted MRI.

Volume: 281x281x386 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case L41 is finished. The final mask was saved from **v6**:

- **Lesion**: large encapsulated lipomatous soft-tissue tumor of the posterior thigh, T1-hyperintense fat core with a thin dark capsule and a less fatty proximal pole; the sciatic/femoral region and normal muscles were excluded.
- **Final mask**: 533.2 mL, single connected component, extent axial 154–321, coronal 85–161, sagittal 86–187 (1 mm isotropic).
- **Workflow**: seeded the fat core with 4 positive points at its largest axial slice, added the heterogeneous proximal pole with points/lasso, extended the distal tip with points at slice 305, removed stray components and thin leakage into the fascia/muscle with component-keeping and a morphological opening, and checked all three planes plus a final five-slice review per plane.
- **Candidates**: all automatic proposals (C1–C3 large, C4–C5 <2 mL) corresponded to subcutaneous/fascial fat and were correctly rejected.
- **Confidence**: medium — the mid and distal boundaries follow the capsule well in all three planes; the very proximal pole is only partially outlined, so a small amount of its less intense periphery may be under-covered.
